# Bronze spear

Internal ID: SpearBronze | Type: Spear | Source: Forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Wood x9, Bronze x12, Deer hide x3 | Attack speed: 1.04 s (includes picking up) | Hitbox: 1.9 range, 40 angle, 1.5 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Bronze spear is the second spear. Its primary attack is a melee attack. Its secondary attack throws the spear for 1.5x damage.
